records.text: French Foreign Legion personnel were on the ground during Charlie Kirk's assassination.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep nPhCKwJ6ye8)

appearances.snippet: they said that the French Foreign Legion was involved and on the ground that day. I've already said that.

verification.notes: Owens attributes this accusation to an unnamed source. Current-source searches found reporting that the Foreign Legion theory was publicly advanced without corroborating evidence, but no official, documentary, or independently verified evidence placing French Foreign Legion personnel at the assassination scene.

conveyance.original_source: private communication with a high-ranking French government source
